chapters.text: Find any call with filters, and see each agent's calling in detail, day by day.

Calls → History: choose From and To dates, a campaign, a result (Interested, Not answered…), and type a name, number or remark. Supervisors can also pick an agent. Agents only ever see their own calls.

Calls → Reports → Agents (detailed): one row per agent with calls, calls per day, days worked, connected, interested (% of connected), callbacks, no answer, switched off, wrong, not interested, duplicate, WhatsApp, talk time and average call, plus the team total. Filter by dates and campaign.
Click an agent's name for their own report: tiles at the top, calls by hour, outcomes, a day-by-day table (click a day for that day's calls), their campaigns and the 50 latest calls with remarks.
Agents open their own report with My report on the History page.

The client replied or called again later? On History press Add on that call: write a remark (it's added to the call and the number's notes), or pick a new result (Interested, Call back…) to save it as a new call. Interested needs remarks and can go to the CRM.
